capabilities: Auto-pair $ signs into inline and display math
Expand snippet triggers like frac, sum, bmatrix into LaTeX code
Insert snippets via a slash-command search inside $$ blocks
Manage custom snippets with add/edit/delete and JSON import/export
Restrict all features to math environments
disambiguation: Not a LaTeX compiler or PDF exporter; it only assists typing math inside $...$ and $$...$$.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README is bilingual (English and Chinese).
problem: Obsidian's editor lacks LaTeX Workshop-style snippet expansion, $ pairing, and math-aware completion when typing formulas.

relations.evidence: VSCode+LaTeX Workshop-like editing experience: snippets, auto-completion, smart newlines

summary: LaTeX editing assistant that adds $ auto-pairing, snippet expansion, and slash-command snippet insertion inside math environments.
